node.title: Re: Prototype Mismatch Errors
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
> What is the best way to fix these warnings without having to go through the whole code?

Looks like two modules are exporting these equally named functions by default, you should definitely decide which one you prefer and block the others!

[METAMOD://Date::Format] is one of them, [DOC://POSIX|POSIX] the other one.

> Is it even possible?

Depends on the modules, look into the documentation, normally you say something like use Module qw(func1 func2); to restrict your selection. See [DOC://use|use] ...

HTH!

Cheers Rolf
(addicted to the Perl Programming Language :)
